description.zh: 需要更新的报警联系人的ID，可调用SearchAlertContact接口来查询，详情请参见[SearchAlertContact](~~130703~~)。
description.en: The ID of the alert contact to be updated. You can call the SearchAlertContact operation to query the contact ID. For more information, see [SearchAlertContact](~~130703~~).

description.zh: 将报警联系人名称改为此名称。
description.en: The new name of the alert contact.

description.zh:
将报警联系人的钉钉机器人Webhook URL修改为此值，获取方式请参见[设置钉钉机器人报警](~~106247~~)。PhoneNum、Email和DingRobotWebhookUrl必须至少填写一个。

> 如果此参数为空，则表示删除报警联系人的该参数。如果此参数设为一个值，则表示更新报警联系人的该参数。
description.en:
The new webhook URL of the DingTalk chatbot. For more information, see [Configure a DingTalk chatbot to send alert notifications](~~106247~~). You must specify at least one of the following parameters: PhoneNum, Email, and DingRobotWebhookUrl.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the original parameter value is deleted. If you specify this parameter, the original parameter value is updated.

description.zh:
将报警联系人的邮箱地址修改为此值。PhoneNum、Email和DingRobotWebhookUrl必须至少填写一个。

> 如果此参数为空，则表示删除报警联系人的该参数。如果此参数设为一个值，则表示更新报警联系人的该参数。
description.en:
The new email address of the alert contact. You must specify at least one of the following parameters: PhoneNum, Email, and DingRobotWebhookUrl.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the original parameter value is deleted. If you specify this parameter, the original parameter value is updated.

description.zh:
将报警联系人的手机号码修改为此值。PhoneNum、Email和DingRobotWebhookUrl必须至少填写一个。

> 如果此参数为空，则表示删除报警联系人的该参数。如果此参数设为一个值，则表示更新报警联系人的该参数。
description.en:
The new mobile phone number of the alert contact. You must specify at least one of the following parameters: PhoneNum, Email, and DingRobotWebhookUrl.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the original parameter value is deleted. If you specify this parameter, the original parameter value is updated.
The ID of the region. Set the value to `cn-hangzhou`.

description.zh:
是否接收系统通知：

- `true`：接收系统通知
- `false`：不接收系统通知
description.en:
Specifies whether the alert contact receives system notifications. Valid values:

*   `true`: The alert contact receives system notifications.
*   `false`: The alert contact does not receive system notifications.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms update-alert-contact --contact-name John_Doe --phone-num 13811110000 --email someone@example.com --ding-robot-webhook-url https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=91f2f60000 --system-noc true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --contact-id 123 --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun arms UpdateAlertContact --region cn-hangzhou --Email 'someone@example.com' --DingRobotWebhookUrl 'https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send0access_token=91f2f60000' --PhoneNum 13811110000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ContactId 123 --ContactName John_Doe --SystemNoc true
